findings.where: Open pull requests table, right-hand columns
findings.evidence: Desktop: only #, Title and Author show, and the table is cut at the card edge, so State, Age and Changes are not visible without scrolling the overflow-x-auto wrapper. Mobile: the Title column is cut mid-word ('with backo', 'payout request', 'dispute view') and State, Age and Changes are off-screen. At both viewports the brief's Age and Changes values (6 d, +412 -87 and so on) cannot be seen.
